plain_statement.zh: 证明每一条充分大的反射带上，大弧系数最大值的主项为 log log N。
plain_statement.en: Identify the leading maximum of the major-arc coefficient on every sufficiently large reflected band.

brief.zh: 与 #4275 的最小值互补。上界可比较截断的 μ²(q)/φ(q) 之和；下界在带内寻找一个被小素数连乘整除的偶数。必须控制不能强迫整除的剩余分母，其符号可能为负。
brief.en: Complement the minimum in #4275. Majorize by the squarefree reciprocal-totient sum. For the lower bound choose a multiple of a suitable primorial inside each band and control the remaining signed denominators.
